figurative_meaning_en: The agony of death, final moments
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার নাভিশ্বাসের মুহূর্তে সকলে কাঁদতে লাগল।
যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রে অনেক যোদ্ধা নাভিশ্বাস ফেলে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: In his final moments, everyone began to weep.
Many warriors drew their last breath on the battlefield.
note: Refers to a deep, profound sigh from the core, symbolizing ultimate exhaustion or demise in Bengali expressive tradition.
